card.name: Last digit of converted unit amounts
card.fires_on: The final digit of a metric conversion number, such as the 6 or 0 in 236 mL or 240 mL after '8 oz', or the 2 in 2.2 lbs. Also fires on 'ounces' in '8 ounces' of water.
